company.notes: Incorporated in Delaware in February 1999 as salesforce.com, inc.; EDGAR shows the current name Salesforce, Inc. from 2022. The IPO prospectus (424B1) was filed 2004-06-23 and the 10-K says the stock has traded on the NYSE as CRM since June 23, 2004. The board was classified at the IPO and declassified as of the 2015 annual meeting (one-year terms). Marc Benioff is Chair and CEO; an independent Lead Independent Director (Arnold Donald since 2025-03-21) is elected by the independent directors.

conflicts.description: Keith Block's exit is dated 2020-02-24 (8-K 'date of earliest event reported' and the 2020 proxy: 'resigned as Co-CEO and a member of the Board on February 24, 2020'), but the 8-K text and press release say the company 'announced' it on February 25, 2020. Recorded 2020-02-24 as the effective date; 2020-02-25 is the announcement date.

The 2014 8-Ks for Colin Powell (March 2014) and Susan Wojcicki (December 2014) both say the board was expanded to eleven members. That implies a departure between them; pre-2020 departures were not researched. Both size events are recorded as stated.

Robin Washington's Lead Independent Director start: the 2025-02-05 8-K says 'since 2022'; the 2023 and 2024 proxies say September 2022. These agree; recorded at month precision because no filing gives the day.

open_questions: Mason Morfit has filed no Form 4 for Salesforce in 2026 (his latest, filed jointly with ValueAct entities, has a period of 2025-12-05; he waives director equity grants). His current status rests on his re-election at the 2026-05-28 annual meeting (Item 5.07) and the 2026 proxy.

Exact days are not disclosed in any Salesforce filing reviewed for: Colin Powell's death (October 2021), Susan Wojcicki's death (August 2024), and the September 2022 Lead Independent Director handover from Robertson to Washington.

Oscar Munoz's change from non-independent to independent is undated. The 2024 proxy expected eligibility as of January 2025, and the 2025 proxy (2025-04-24) lists him as independent. Recorded at year precision (2025).

Pre-IPO start days are not disclosed: Benioff (February 1999, 'since inception'; the prospectus gives company inception as February 3, 1999 but does not tie his board seat to that day), Robertson (October 2003) and Hassenfeld (December 2003).

Maynard Webb's decision not to stand in 2026 appears only in the 2026 proxy (no 8-K Item 5.02 was filed for it). The board's authorized size after the 2026 meeting (13 directors elected) is not stated.

Keith Block's 'Vice Chairman' title (2013-2018) is recorded as an officer title on his executive-director role, not as a board vice_chair role. The filings call it 'Vice Chairman of the Company', not of the Board.
Parker Harris's Form 4 officer title changed from 'Co-Founder and CTO, Slack' (period 2026-08-28) to 'Co-Founder' (period 2026-09-22). No 8-K explains this; his board seat is unaffected.

Independence roles are aligned to board tenure. The filings give point-in-time determinations (appointment 8-Ks and each proxy), plus explicit statements that former directors were independent throughout their service.
Committee membership is captured only at proxy snapshots (2026 for current directors; each departed director's last proxy). Changes between proxies are not dated.
Directors who left before 2020 (e.g., Bernard Tyson, who died in 2019) are not recorded, as scoped.

coverage.method: Roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A, the 2026 Item 5.07 results (2026-05-28), every 8-K with Item 5.02 filed after the proxy (2026-06-01, 2026-06-02, 2026-08-05, 2026-09-04: none concern directors), every Form 3 since 2014, and every Form 3/4 filed in 2026 through 2026-09-23, the latest filing in the EDGAR submissions feed. Twelve of thirteen current directors filed director Forms 4 in 2026; Morfit's latest is 2025-12.

Every DEF 14A from 2019 to 2026 and every 8-K with Item 5.02 or 5.07 from 2019 to 2026 reviewed; annual-meeting slates compared year over year; every Form 3 with isDirector checked. Departures dated from 8-K Item 5.02, from the Item 5.07 meeting date for directors who did not stand, or (deaths, Block) from proxy statements.

Pre-2020 seats only for directors serving in 2020 or later, from the 2004 IPO prospectus, appointment 8-Ks and Forms 3. Other pre-2020 directors (e.g., Bernard Tyson, Stratton Sclavos, Shirley Young, Craig Ramsey, Larry Tomlinson, Magdalena Yesil) are not recorded.
